tools.name: search_blocks
tools.description: Search the shadcn/ui blocks listed on shadcn.exchange: ready-made sections of a page, such as heroes, pricing tables, login forms, dashboards, footers and FAQs, from every public shadcn registry, free and paid. Use it when the user is building a page or a screen with shadcn/ui and wants a section to

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Get one block's details by its id from search_blocks: what it is, its install command, the npm packages and registry items it depends on, the files it adds, and its registry's notes on using it. Set include_source to also get its source code, for when the user wants to read or adapt the code rather

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the kinds of section the blocks are sorted into, such as hero, pricing, login, dashboard and footer, with how many blocks each has. Pass one to search_blocks as its category.

tools.name: list_registries
tools.description: List the public shadcn/ui registries whose blocks shadcn.exchange lists, the most blocks first, with how many of each are free and paid, what each one is, and its page. Pass a registry's id to search_blocks to search only its blocks.
